title: Operator Task Order Input v1
description: An ordinary service-order's inert input for a bounded task-pack order. Selects the exact signed offer and task profile, never local authority. Dator additionally limits question/text to 8192 UTF-8 bytes. The provider operator explicitly links the retained order to a provider-owned local round; admission grants neither a loop nor HIL.

selected-offer/digest.description: JCS v1 digest of the complete selected signed Service Offer, including its signature.
